verdict.rationale: x402 is built for exactly this story. Sellers add a line of code so unpaid requests get an HTTP 402, and agents sign a payment and retry per request, 'without checkout pages, subscriptions, or separate billing integrations.' A hosted facilitator handles verification and settlement. Independent operators confirm server-side per-request monetization (httpay.xyz with 124 endpoints, Apiosk), and a runtime probe found live payable listings on Base.

support.subject: As a developer, I can monetize an API or service with HTTP 402 machine payments that agents pay per call without a checkout UI

citations.quote: Add one line of code to require payment for each incoming request. If a request arrives without payment, the server responds with HTTP 402, prompting the client to pay and retry.
x402 is an open standard for adding per-request payments to HTTP, so APIs and services can charge without checkout pages, subscriptions, or separate billing integrations.
AI agent pays instantly with stablecoins No signups or approvals required
a gateway that enforces per-request x402 payments so API providers can monetize without accounts or keys.
